title: Zebra waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="62" rx="20" ry="14" fill="#e8e8e8"/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x="32" y="72" width="5" height="16" rx="2" fill="#e8e8e8"/>
  <rect x="40" y="72" width="5" height="16" rx="2" fill="#d0d0d0"/>
  <rect x="50" y="72" width="5" height="16" rx="2" fill="#e8e8e8"/>
  <rect x="57" y="72" width="5" height="16" rx="2" fill="#d0d0d0"/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x="31" y="85" width="7" height="4" rx="2" fill="#4a4a6a"/>
  <rect x="39" y="85" width="7" height="4" rx="2" fill="#4a4a6a"/>
  <rect x="49" y="85" width="7" height="4" rx="2" fill="#4a4a6a"/>
  <rect x="56" y="85" width="7" height="4" rx="2" fill="#4a4a6a"/>
  <!-- Stripes on body -->
  <path d="M30 56 Q35 55 33 62" stroke="#3a3a5a" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M37 54 Q42 53 40 62" stroke="#3a3a5a" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M44 53 Q49 52 47 62" stroke="#3a3a5a" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M51 54 Q56 53 54 62" stroke="#3a3a5a" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M58 56 Q62 55 60 64" stroke="#3a3a5a" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <path d="M55 54 Q60 40 63 35 L72 38 Q68 45 65 55 Z" fill="#e8e8e8"/>
  <path d="M58 48 L68 46" stroke="#3a3a5a" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M60 42 L70 40" stroke="#3a3a5a" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Mane -->
  <path d="M55 54 Q58 44 62 36" stroke="#3a3a5a" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="33" rx="12" ry="9" fill="#e8e8e8" transform="rotate(-15 70 33)"/>
  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx="80" cy="38" rx="6" ry="5" fill="#f0d0d0"/>
  <!-- Nostril -->
  <circle cx="83" cy="38" r="1.2" fill="#3a3a5a"/>
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx="73" cy="30" r="2" fill="#3a3a5a"/>
  <circle cx="73.5" cy="29.5" r="0.7" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- Ear -->
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="22" rx="3" ry="5" fill="#e8e8e8" transform="rotate(-20 64 22)"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="22" rx="1.5" ry="3" fill="#f0d0d0" transform="rotate(-20 64 22)"/>
  <!-- Head stripe -->
  <path d="M68 25 Q72 27 70 31" stroke="#3a3a5a" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Waving arm -->
  <path d="M57 50 Q65 38 72 22 Q74 18 78 20 Q80 22 77 26 Q70 44 62 54" fill="#e8e8e8" stroke="#d0d0d0" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Hoof on waving arm -->
  <circle cx="76" cy="21" r="3.5" fill="#4a4a6a"/>
  <!-- Other arm -->
  <path d="M38 58 Q30 62 28 68" stroke="#e8e8e8" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="28" cy="69" r="3" fill="#4a4a6a"/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d="M25 60 Q18 58 16 64" stroke="#3a3a5a" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="16" cy="66" r="2.5" fill="#3a3a5a"/>
</svg>
